# Unicorn 2.1.4

The standalone player includes the unmodified official Windows wheel's Unicorn
engine and Python binding. Preserve the upstream license texts in this folder,
the wheel metadata, and the accompanying source archive when packaging.

- Upstream: <https://github.com/unicorn-engine/unicorn/tree/2.1.4>
- Original source distribution: `unicorn-2.1.4.tar.gz` from the official PyPI
  release <https://pypi.org/project/unicorn/2.1.4/#files>.
- Source archive SHA-256:
  `00567a70e323f749b419cd86bee4f9115beab7ebba32194581c090cbb7c59cff`.
- `COPYING`, `COPYING.LGPL2` and `COPYING_GLIB` are the original upstream files.
  The source archive contains the complete component license notices.

The engine is covered by the upstream GPL terms; the binding's package metadata
also records its own license. These components are not relicensed as Rhine's MIT
application code. The runtime wheel's exact URL and SHA-256 are pinned in
`desktop/runtime-assets.json`.
